title: Webページの本文を、Markdownで取り出す

source.what_it_is: A JavaScript library that takes a DOM Document and returns the main content plus metadata (title, author, ...). The full bundle converts content to Markdown (full parse() = base parse() then toMarkdown). Not a SKILL.md, model, AI summarizer or quality judge.
source.bundle: vendor/defuddle/defuddle.full.js: the full UMD bundle generated in the original production from this fixed source and lockfile; not an official raw source file; not rebuilt for this revision; loaded with SRI sha256-97OQdFKjN1nwxyEGxLwziIbt8vRY4/O6+CAt8TiUA5Q= after the 21-file gate

sizes.composition: rail/title/sub at top, diagram world 700x1026 at y=206 using the tall concept layout (page left, file/Document/settings right column, Defuddle machine across, returned value + check/.md/memo/viewer below), foot line at y=1256

title/sub left, rail right, diagram world 1240x576 at y=112 using the separate wide concept layout (page | file-Document-settings | machine with stacked rooms | returned value, check, .md, memo, viewer), foot line at y=706

assets.live_library_calls: After the gate, the page loads the verified full UMD bundle once and calls new Defuddle(new DOMParser().parseFromString(sample.input, 'text/html'), {url: sample.url, markdown: true, useAsync: false, removeImages: true}).parse() once for each of the 3 samples. title, author and content must equal extraction-results.json / samples.json exactly, and the UTF-8 bytes of content must equal outputs/<id>.md (size and SHA-256). Frames draw the values returned for reading. No call per frame, no Node run, no AI, no network fetch of example.test.

persistent_shapes: page: the fictional reading page drawn from the input HTML regions (nav/header, ad, article, related sidebar, subscription footer). Outside regions become hatched grey with dashed borders and short labels ナビ/広告/関連/購読; the article gets a solid indigo frame with heading bars, two-line paragraphs and bullet rows in input order. Not a screenshot.
file: reading.html (dog-ear file, 'HTMLの文字列'); a shrinking copy of the page enters it
doc: Document (DOMParser) with head chips 題名/著者 (sepia tags) and body chips ナビ/広告/本文/関連/購読 in the same hatched/indigo forms
opts: url example.test/reading (not fetched), markdown true, useAsync false, removeImages true
machine: one Defuddle box with tab 'Defuddle full', note 中は説明図, and three rooms: 題名・著者 (tag icon), 本文を選ぶ (magnifier, dashed sieve 外す, tray), Markdown (## and - marks)
meta tags: two sepia tags travel Document -> intake -> 題名・著者 room -> top of the returned value
article blocks: the same block forms travel Document -> intake -> under the magnifier -> Markdown room -> rows of the returned value; then morph into ## / - marks and the real returned text
clutter blocks: four hatched blocks travel Document -> intake -> through the sieve into the tray (conceptual, not a deletion log)
card (返る値): title and author from the live result, content rows from the live Markdown blocks
check (語句の照合（作例）): 残る n/4 and 入らない n/3 counted from the live content; indigo marks on the rows that contain the kept phrases
mdfile: reading.md with its byte size; memo (メモ) and viewer (元のページ, the same page form in miniature)

scenes.title: Defuddle：本文を取り出すライブラリ
scenes.sub: JavaScript・中に「題名・著者」「本文を選ぶ」「Markdown」
scenes.conveys: What the tool is: a library box whose inside has three parts. No skill book, no AI brain.
scenes.incoming: Empty frame; camera centred on the machine.
scenes.events: Machine appears (0.2-0.9 s); lid lifts (1.0-2.0 s); rooms appear 題名・著者 (1.4-1.9 s), 本文を選ぶ (1.8-2.3 s), Markdown (2.2-2.7 s); inner lines draw (2.6-3.3 s).
scenes.outgoing: Camera moves to the input area (3.3-4.0 s).

scenes.title: 渡す：ページのHTMLをDocumentに
scenes.sub: fixtures/reading.html → DOMParser　URL（取得しない）と3つの設定を添える
scenes.conveys: What is supplied: an HTML string parsed into a Document, plus a context URL and three settings. The page is a diagram drawn from the input HTML.
scenes.events: Regions separate and colour (4.5-5.6 s); file appears and the page copy shrinks into it (5.3-6.4 s); Document tree chips appear one by one (6.1-7.1 s); settings lines appear (6.7-7.7 s); line into the machine (7.4-8.1 s).

scenes.title: 取り出す：題名・著者と本文を分ける
scenes.sub: 本文を選び、外側の領域を外す（説明図・内部の記録ではない）
scenes.conveys: Inside: metadata is a separate branch; the article is kept and gathered under the magnifier; outside regions fall through the sieve. Conceptual, from the source documentation; not a measured trace, selector or timing.
scenes.events: Meta tags travel to the 題名・著者 room (8.6-10.4 s); clutter blocks drop into the tray (9.4-12.4 s); article blocks gather under the magnifier (9.8-12.8 s).
scenes.outgoing: Returned-value card appears (13.8-14.3 s); camera moves to machine + card (13.6-14.3 s).

scenes.title: 本文が、Markdownの行になる
scenes.sub: ## 見出し3・段落4・- リスト4項目　title と author も返る (counts read from the live result at runtime)
scenes.conveys: The same blocks become Markdown rows; metadata joins the returned value. Text is the actual returned content, shown as short rows, not a full-text slide.
scenes.incoming: Tags resting in the meta room, blocks under the magnifier.
scenes.events: Tags move to title/author and the real values appear (14.4-15.6 s); blocks pass the Markdown room into rows (14.8-17.0 s); camera zooms on the card (16.6-17.3 s); marks ## / - and the returned text replace the shapes (17.0-18.6 s).
scenes.outgoing: Camera moves to card + check (19.6-20.3 s).

scenes.title: 語句を文字どおり照合（作例側）
scenes.sub: 残る4語はすべてある・本文の外の3語は無い　意味や品質の採点ではない
scenes.conveys: A separate case-side literal check on the live content: rows containing 10月24日14時 / 定員8人 / 申込は前日18時まで / 参加無料 get indigo marks; the three outside phrases are absent. Not a Defuddle feature, not semantic accuracy, no score.
scenes.events: Check node appears (20.0-20.4 s); kept marks and counts appear one by one, then the absent count (20.8-25.0 s).
scenes.outgoing: Camera moves to the use area (25.6-26.3 s).

scenes.title: 保存して、読む・見比べる
scenes.sub: reading.md（1,294 B）→ メモ・元のページ
scenes.conveys: The same rows become the real reading.md (size from the validated file) and are used: pasted to a memo and compared with the original page. Illustration only; no OS clipboard or save happens in the film.
scenes.events: .md slot appears (26.0-26.4 s); the card rows shrink into reading.md (26.3-27.2 s); memo and viewer appear (27.0-27.4 s); a copy goes to the memo and the viewer shows the original page form (27.4-28.3 s).

scenes.title: Webページの本文を、Markdownで取り出す
scenes.sub: 渡す → 取り出す → 使う　同梱のfull版の実際の戻り値から描画
scenes.conveys: Stable whole path, understandable without sound.
scenes.incoming: All lines flow-coloured and emphasis back to full (28.3-28.9 s); camera pulls back to the whole diagram (28.2-28.9 s); title and rail switch 28.5-28.9 s.
scenes.events: None. Still from 28.9 s to 32 s; poster at 31 s.

quoted_values_source: title, author, Markdown rows, heading/paragraph/list counts and kept-phrase rows come from the live parse() result for reading (equal to the saved results); file name and byte size from the validated outputs/reading.md; region forms from the input HTML in samples.json.
limits: Inside-the-machine motion is an explanation, not Defuddle's internal deletion log, chosen content selector, order or timing.
removeImages has no demonstrated effect (the inputs contain no images); the third-party API fallback is disabled and not exercised.
HTML output, CLI, math, footnotes and arbitrary web pages are not tested. example.test URLs are context identifiers and are never fetched.
The research and operation pages are fictional; no real app save or real study.
